authoritative_method_source.title: Accounting for electron-beam-induced warping of molecular nanocrystals in MicroED structure determination
claim_boundary: These are cohort-level published method facts and are not immutable per-file acquisition identifiers.
The method source does not by itself bind a specific series#.tvips file to a unique crystal identity or acquisition ID.
The audited method evidence is not treated as a traceable camera-length, camera-constant, beam-centre, or reciprocal-scale calibration.

acceptable_evidence: source-supported pattern centre for the selected acquisition
independently reproducible centre-calibration procedure frozen before analyzer tuning
traceable camera constant or reciprocal-space calibration for the selected acquisition
camera length plus detector geometry and a documented conversion validated against an independent reference
source-assigned immutable sample/crystal ID and acquisition/series ID
authoritative mapping from the exact TVIPS series to a source-defined crystal/acquisition record
source-author reflection/ring assignments with traceable phase and zone-axis context
independently curated structure/reference plus a predeclared indexing protocol

next_evidence_requirement.why: This is the narrowest unresolved blocker that changes whether quantitative SAED indexing validation is scientifically admissible.

scientific_boundary: This contract combines already verified repository evidence with published cohort-level method facts; it does not inspect new diffraction pixels.
A structurally valid TVIPS header and known microscope/detector model do not establish reciprocal calibration or beam centre.
No phase, reflection, zone-axis, analyzer-performance, external-validation, or engineering claim is authorized by this assessment.
